basic_profile.bio: Hailing from the tech hub of Austin, Texas, I'm a 25-year-old software developer with a passion for building custom PCs. My journey into the world of technology began in high school, where I started tinkering with hardware and software. Outside work, I enjoy competitive gaming and creating video content using Kdenlive, often sharing my projects on Reddit. I'm currently single and typically online during late evenings, perfect for unwinding after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I've self-taught most of my technical skills through online resources, countless YouTube tutorials, and hands-on experience. My educational background includes a degree in Computer Science, which solidified my foundation in software development.
